injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Draymond Green
injuries.detail: Green (elbow) is out for Thursday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.

injuries.name: LJ Cryer
injuries.detail: Cryer (back) is questionable for Thursday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Ty Jerome
injuries.detail: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.detail: Edey (hip) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart is questionable for Thursday's game against the Warriors due to an illness.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kyle Kuzma
injuries.detail: Kuzma (shoulder) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Portland due to a right shoulder contusion.

injuries.name: Myles Turner
injuries.detail: Turner (shoulder) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Portland due to a left shoulder contusion,

injuries.name: Ousmane Dieng
injuries.detail: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Jonathan Kuminga
injuries.detail: Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Knicks, Charlie Walton of ZoneCoverage.com reports.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Deni Avdija
injuries.detail: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable ahead of Thursday's game against Milwaukee.

injuries.name: Toumani Camara
injuries.detail: Camara is questionable to play Thursday against the Bucks due to general soreness.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Robert Williams III
injuries.detail: Williams (rest) is listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Bucks.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.detail: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
